scope: Publish two artist-supplied works by Michael Conor Kushman (Tetra; Songbird, supplied as Oscen.usdz and retitled by the artist) and apply the artist’s corrections to Dragon’s Mouth before resuming African acquisitions. Heights were supplied in inches and are displayed in metric.
newest_behavior: Rolling 24 latest public works by import time; neutral page.

record.title: Tetra
record.note: Crumpled aluminum gathers into a compact, many-faceted mass. Pale blue, magenta, violet, and pink paint moves across the folds, with pale gray streaks in the creases.
record.scan_source: 3D file supplied directly by the artist. Original captured color, surface detail, and geometry retained in the web version. Display scale is estimated from the approximate height supplied by the artist.
record.license: Displayed with permission of the artist; all rights retained.
record.attribution: Tetra by Michael Conor Kushman. Aluminum, acrylic, and spray paint. 3D file supplied by the artist; displayed with permission. All rights retained.

license_evidence.title: Tetra
license_evidence.license_basis: The artist supplied this file and explicitly requested publication to Atrium; this is display permission, not a Creative Commons grant.
license_evidence.source_acquisition: Direct artist-supplied USDZ attachment (RealityKit Object Capture 3.9.4).
license_evidence.derivative_provenance: Opened the USDZ with Pixar USD (usd-core 26.8). Copied every triangle, point, vertex normal and faceVarying UV unchanged into a self-contained GLB, flipping V only for glTF’s top-left texture origin; embedded the three PNG textures byte-for-byte. UsdPreviewSurface mapped to glTF metallic-roughness (baseColor, normal and occlusion textures; roughness 0.9; metallic 0). Applied one uniform scale about the ground-plane origin so the height equals the artist’s stated height. Internal capture paths, capture identifiers and layer metadata were not carried over. Optimized with glTF-Transform 4.4.2 (meshopt, 2048-pixel WebP textures) without geometry simplification.
license_evidence.dimensions_basis: Artist-supplied approximate height of 7.3 in (18.54 cm, shown as 18.5 cm). Source model height 0.3845 units; uniform scale 0.4822411228905652. Width is the X extent and depth the Z extent of the model’s axis-aligned bounds, relative to the opening view from +Z. Creation year 2023 and American origin supplied by the artist.
license_evidence.dedup_review: Artist name and title checked against all 1,546 baseline records; the only prior Michael Conor Kushman work is Dragon’s Mouth, a different composition.

visual_review.geometry_notes: Converted and optimized models reviewed from front, right, rear, left, top and underside through the production render page. Compact crumpled aluminum form; pale blue, magenta, violet and pink paint with silvery streaks retained. The scan has no floor, plinth or mount; nothing was removed, generated or filled. Darker underside recesses are part of the folded sheet as captured.
visual_review.optimization: No triangle simplification; texture compression and meshopt only.
visual_review.conversion_audit: 16300 triangles and 8152 source points retained; GLB vertices are the unique (point, UV) corner pairs.

dimensions_review.note: Height is approximate and supplied by the artist. Width and depth are estimated from the scan’s proportions relative to the opening view; these are not independent physical measurements.
dimensions_review.spatialNote: Approximate height supplied by the artist; the model’s proportions are preserved.
